message.text: Found the s3presign runner. Reading runner.go and server.go to identify its schedule and startup wiring.

The S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`) prevents external attachment links from becoming stale.

It refreshes links every 12 hours. It is wired into server startup in `startBackgroundRunners` at line 129.

The S3 presign runner keeps external attachment links fresh.

Presigned S3 URLs expire after five days and refresh automatically when fewer than four days remain. The `s3presign` runner handles this. The `AttachmentStorageType_EXTERNAL` path stores raw links without automatic refresh.

**s3presign.Runner** — every 12 hours — `server/server.go:129`

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` refreshes presigned S3 URLs stored in attachment `Reference` fields so externally stored attachment links do not expire. It lists S3 attachments, skips those whose presigned URL is still valid for at least 4 more days (URLs are issued with a 5-day lifetime in `internal/storage/s3/s3.go`), and updates stale ones via `CheckAndPresign`.

The schedule is defined as:

// Schedule runner every 12 hours.
